purpose: 24h-class GPU-bound PPO benchmarks for AMD RX 7900 GRE; supersedes CPU-heavy Gym/MuJoCo as primary research signal.

validated_local_backend.smoke_test: JAX matmul and Craftax-Symbolic-v1 reset/step succeeded on RX 7900 GRE

tiers.name: craftax_gpu_jax_primary
tiers.why: JAX-native environment and training path; long-horizon sparse open-world benchmark; verified ROCm GPU step locally.

tiers.name: mujoco_playground_mjx_robotics
tiers.why: GPU-accelerated robot learning and sim-to-real tasks via MuJoCo MJX; better hard-robotics match than classic Gym MuJoCo.
tiers.risk: Official docs emphasize CUDA JAX; must verify under JAX ROCm on RX 7900 GRE.

tiers.name: brax_mjx_fallback
tiers.why: Accelerator-native JAX physics and PPO training; useful fallback if MuJoCo Playground is too CUDA-oriented.

tiers.name: procgen_visual_generalization
tiers.why: Hard visual generalization with CNN policy, but environment generation is CPU-side; not primary GPU-sim benchmark.

tiers.name: genesis_world_exploratory
tiers.why: Claims AMD ROCm backend and robotics/multi-physics scope; RL maturity/path needs verification.

tiers.name: isaac_lab_deprioritized
tiers.why: Hard robot sims, but NVIDIA Isaac Sim/RTX/CUDA stack is not practical for AMD ROCm machine.
